scope: Nested advisory and business-plan report failures

behavior.business_plan_sections: Best-effort section errors contain only the operation and bounded exception class; transaction rollback remains intact.
behavior.reference_class: Reference-class analysis errors omit exception details from the financial-plan payload.
behavior.reward_calibration: Overjustification advisory errors omit exception details from the public-safe report payload.
behavior.simulation_wargame: Reserve-clash advisory errors omit exception details while preserving the rest of the simulation report.

coverage: business-plan section failure rolls back and returns only exception class
reference-class advisory failure is sanitized in the financial plan
existing business-plan, report, and reward-calibration contracts remain covered

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked connections and advisory functions

limitations: Two database-backed business-plan integration tests were skipped because no database was configured.
This does not establish populated report-output parity or authorization scope.
